title: Session-expiry impact analysis
objective: Identify every directly affected specification and implementation area after a session lifetime change.
brief: SESSION-POLICY defines interactive lifetime as 24 hours and is used by AUTH-SERVICE and MOBILE-SESSION-UI.
Change interactive session lifetime from 24 hours to 8 hours.
API-TOKEN-POLICY and RESET-TOKEN-POLICY are related reading but must not change.
MOBILE-SESSION-UI caches the displayed expiry time and has its own test plan.

baseline: Represent the brief as linked ordinary Markdown and use repository search.
Return an impact list with reasons.
bitz: Represent the same brief with typed .spec relations and use context/check evidence.
Return the same impact list with statement references.

completionCriteria: Session policy, authentication implementation, mobile display, and their tests are included.
API-token and reset-token specifications are explicitly excluded with reasons.
